title: Evidence & fact model
description: Traceability model for sell-side claims (Plan §10.2, §17). Every factual claim and superlative on a slide should trace to a source fact. Three layers are kept distinct: source fact -> permitted interpretation -> slide language, so the system neither copies raw source text nor makes unsupported claims.

fact.description: The atomic fact, e.g. 'The company has 42 employees and average tenure is nine years.'

claimTrace.description: Links a generated slide element to the facts that support it (Plan §10.7).

layer2_interpretation.description: Permitted reading of the fact (e.g. 'The workforce is experienced and stable.')

evidenceForAdjective.description: Required when a Class-B/C adjective is used (see adjective-lexicon.json claimEvidence).

bulletHierarchy.note: Plan §12 — do not write every element as a full paragraph.
bulletHierarchy.level1_takeaway: Complete, assertive sentence (slide takeaway or key-message band).
